title: Enterprise Connectivity: issuance export volume
content:
## Application
Enterprise Connectivity applies this issuance export volume rule to net transfer invoice.

## Basis: volume
For net transfer invoice, read the posted primary internet outbound transfer volume for the exact selected export bundle identifier and its source billing month; cancelled records, other source bundles, other meters and other periods are excluded.

## Basis Q&A
| Net transfer invoice basis | Consequence for this action |
| --- | --- |
| Net transfer invoice: Read the posted primary internet outbound transfer volume for the exact selected export bundle identifier and its source billing month | cancelled records, other source bundles, other meters and other periods are excluded. |

## Hypothetical export selection
For a hypothetical net transfer invoice, a posted primary internet outbound export naming the selected bundle and its billing month contributes its measured volume. A cancelled export or an export for another bundle contributes none, even if it is recorded in the same month.
